summary: Macro Bank Inc. filed a Form 6-K reporting it has not yet received Argentine central bank approval for its acquisition of all outstanding shares of Banco Sáenz S.A. The registrant is the acquirer; terms such as price, premium, and advisors are not disclosed in this update. The filing notes that once approval is received it will be disclosed to investors. This is a cross-border acquisition pending a key regulatory go-ahead from the Central Bank of Argentina. Watch for the regulatory decision as the sole condition precedent; a delayed or denied approval would terminate the deal, while approval triggers final closing.
